limitations: Specified initial transition operator and spatial cut only; infinite-volume limit before large-time limit.
Fixed accuracy and fixed rank-exponent limits; not uniform in accuracy tending to zero.
Does not prove globally minimal matrix-product-operator bond dimension or noise-robust simulation.
A preliminary public manuscript from 2026-09-04 was not available for full-text inspection; priority remains subject to independent review.
scientific_integrity: A new single-cut sharp compression theorem derived from and crediting the published count-block spectra, not an independent derivation of the integrable circuit or a claim of global MPO optimality.
title: Sharp fixed-accuracy Schmidt-rank profile of an integrable brickwork circuit
